### 🎉 Release: v2.0.0 — Modern Async Architecture, Platinum Quality Scale & OWNd 2.0.1

First stable **`v2.0.0`** release of **MyHOME for Home Assistant** (**1,870+ commits** and **420+ merged pull requests** since `v0.9.4`), built on **[`OWNd 2.0.1`](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/OWNd)** and relicensed under **[Apache License 2.0](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/blob/master/LICENSE)**. Requires **Home Assistant 2026.8 or newer** (Python 3.14); ready for the **Home Assistant 2026.11+ Marketplace** (`hubs_protocols.building_automation`) and **HACS** (`2026.8 – 2026.10`). Verified in CI with **6,554 automated tests (100.0% statement coverage across 20,243 statements in 71 integration modules)**, **455 Golden Corpus fixtures across 21 WHO subsystems**, **520 Firmware Oracle inputs across 17 gateway targets**, and authentic on-wire captures across **14 gateway models**.

> *"In traces we find the truth."*

#### ⚠️ Upgrading from v0.9.4 (Compatibility & Zero-Friction Migration)

- **Minimum Version**: Requires **Home Assistant Core 2026.8+** (Python 3.14). Installations on older Home Assistant versions should remain on [`v0.9.4`](https://openwebnet-ha.github.io/MyHOME/0.9.4/).
- **In-Place Migration**: Existing `v0.9.4` config entries and `/config/myhome.yaml` declarations migrate automatically into config-entry settings (`migrate.py`, `legacy_yaml.py`), preserving deterministic entity unique IDs (`<mac>-<who>-<where>`) and `compat_name` registry names across Home Assistant 2026.11+. Always take a full backup first and follow **[Upgrading from v0.9.4](https://openwebnet-ha.github.io/MyHOME/latest/migration/upgrade-from-094/)**.
- **License**: Relicensed under **Apache License 2.0** (#922), matching Home Assistant Core and `OWNd`.

#### 🌟 Major Capabilities in v2.0.0 (vs. v0.9.4)

- **Standalone Async `OWNd 2.0.1` Engine & 11 IP Gateway Profiles**: Non-blocking asyncio TCP engine (`mypy --strict`, 0 errors), clear-text / numeric / HMAC-SHA1 / HMAC-SHA256 handshakes, per-target priority `FrameScheduler`, idle command-socket recovery, and firmware-aware profiles across `F454`, `F455`, `F461`, `MH202`, `MH201`, `MyHomeServer1`, `MH200N`, `MH200`, `H4890 / AM4890` (incl. `Legrand 067292`), `F452 / F453 / F453AV`, and `H4684 / H/L4684` (plus `F459` `WHO = 1013` identification; `Legrand 3578` USB/serial OpenZigBee deferred to `v2.1+`).
- **Home Assistant 🏆 Platinum Quality Scale (54/54 rules)**: Typed `entry.runtime_data`, `OptionsFlowWithReload`, in-place **Reconfigure** (`host` / `port` / `password`), self-clearing **Home Assistant Repairs** (`actuator_fault`, gateway identity mismatches, unconfigured timezone `999`), PII-redacted **Diagnostics**, HA websession injection for UPnP, and bundled local brand assets.
- **Multi-Gateway Topologies**: Standalone isolated buses, shared-bus **Primary / Secondary** (WHO delegation without duplicate YAML/actuator/button entities), and **Warm Standby** automatic failover when a primary gateway drops.
- **11 Entity Platforms + UI Device Triggers**:
  - **Lighting (`WHO = 1`)**: Relays, coarse/fine dimmers, DALI DT8 tunable white & HSV color (`lock_features`), software-stepped fades, hardware-offloaded DIN bus timers (`myhome.turn_on_timed`), declared physical groups (`#G`), and debounced broadcast resync.
  - **Covers (`WHO = 2` & `WHO = 1`) & Door-Entry Locks (`WHO = 6`)**: Pluggable kinematics (`simple`, `timed` with ~1 s live interpolated position animation, `min_motor_pulse`, `min_position_delta`, and `myhome.calibrate_cover` on-bus stopwatch calibration, `native` `Dimension 10/11` with automatic `Dimension 10` promotion, and `venetian` slat tilt), impulse gate/garage covers with optional safety approval, and constant-time PIN `lock` entities + intercom call events (`WHO = 6 / 8`).
  - **Thermoregulation (`WHO = 4`)**: Zone thermostats, 3-speed & `0–10 V` fancoils (`Dimension 11 / 19 / 20`), `Dimension 13` local knob offsets, `Dimension 60` zone humidity, 99-zone `3550` (`#0`, `*4*3100*#0##` weekly program restore) & 4-zone `4695` (`#0#1`) central units, probe-less thermo actuator switches, and paced startup sweeps.
  - **Multi-Room Audio & FM RDS Tuners (`WHO = 16` & `WHO = 22`)**: `F441` / `F441M` matrix zones, `DecoderPool` dynamic streaming proxy for **Music Assistant** / Cast / DLNA companions, anti-hiss auto-off & group handover, and `F500` / `F500N` FM RDS tuners (`media_player`, `number`, `button`).
  - **Energy (`WHO = 18`), Sensors, PIR Motion (`WHO = 1`), Dry Contacts (`WHO = 9 / 25`), Burglar Alarm (`WHO = 5`) & CEN/CEN+ (`WHO = 15 / 25`)**: `F520` / `F521` / `3522` active power (`W`) and unit-safe `RestoreSensor` energy totalizers (`Wh` / `kWh`), temperature/lux sensors, exact-timer Scenarios-mode & `WHAT 39` Stand-alone PIR motion sensors, invertible dry contacts, read-only `3485` / `3486` alarm panel with optional AUX arm/disarm, and 8-action UI device triggers.
- **Expose Home Assistant to the SCS Bus (`expose`) & In-Band Bus Monitor (`<myhome-openwebnet-bus-monitor>`)**: Virtual `WHO = 1` / `2` actuators (with `H4652/2` hold-up step-up, retry deduplication, and custom Home Assistant scripts), firmware-gated `WHO = 4` / `18` virtual probes, `WHO = 13` bus clock sync, and zero-extra-socket 500-frame live Lovelace Bus Monitor with 1-click redacted trace export.

#### 🔧 Final Changes Since v2.0.0b18 (#906, #912–#915, #919–#923, #927–#929, #931, #933, #935, #937–#940, #942)

- **Energy Totalizer `RestoreSensor` Unit-Safe Restore (#907, #913, #919, #920)**: `MyHOMESensor` (`sensor.py`) now inherits `RestoreSensor` (`async_get_last_sensor_data`), restoring `native_value` alongside its stored `native_unit_of_measurement` (`kWh → Wh`) so user unit overrides to `kWh` never divide restored readings by 1,000 across restarts.
- **Thermoregulation `Dimension 19 / 20` Output Codes, Multi-Actuator `F455` Zone State, Silent-Zone & Probe Fallback Polling & Standalone `N4692` Knob Detents (#908, #912, #914, #919–#921, #928–#929, #933, #938, #940, `OWNd#174`, `OWNd#178`, `OWNd#181`)**: `WHO = 4` `Dimension 19`, `Dimension 20`, and `#20` codes `14..16` (`MyHomeServer1`/`F461` extended fan-coil OFF speeds) and `100` (`0%` proportional `0–10 V` / Sabiana Auto-idle) decode as inactive rather than active heating/cooling fans, and `10..13` / `17..22` follow the `bt_thermo_manager` active/inactive bitmask; standalone BTicino `N4692` physical knob detents (`±1..±3 °C` via `Dimension 13` + `_local_target_base` pairing, Discussion #770) update `target_temperature`; silent `WHO = 4` zones across every gateway run a paced, result-based post-sweep poll (`30 s` grace) for missing temperature, knob, setpoints, remembered actuator numbers (`1..9`), and — on `F455` where the zone-form `*#4*Z*20##` is refused — `Dimension 19` (`*#4*Z*19##`) as the final authoritative read so multi-actuator zones (e.g. valve on actuator 1 + fan coil on actuator 2) report their active state and ignore repeated `off` echoes from already-off actuators (#940); `WHERE >= 100` temperature probes wait `15 min` (`900 s`) between fallback reads and stop on gateway NACK/timeout refusal (#938); `OWNd 2.0.1` (`F455Profile`) sets `supports_general_heating_status = False` and `supports_heating_humidity_request = False`; live BTicino `3550` `*4*3100*#0##` weekly program restore trace added (#912).
- **Scenarios-Mode PIR Motion Sensor Exact Timer & `WHAT 39` Safety Hold (#941, #942)**: Replaced the 30 s polling loop and `+ 15 s` margin on `MyHOMEMotionSensor` (`WHO = 1`, e.g. `K4659` in Scenarios mode `Object 128`) with an exact one-shot `async_call_later` timer (`DIMENSION 7 + 3 s` grace), while preserving a 10-minute safety hold for Stand-alone detectors that emit `WHAT 39` (`#777`), adapting automatically if a user lengthens `DIMENSION 7` at runtime, and scoping `_last_updated` strictly to motion/clear events.
- **Covers `WHO = 2` `Dimension 10` Auto-Detection & Mid-Move Target Hand-Off (#927, #935)**: Standard covers automatically promote to native `Dimension 10` positioning upon receiving valid `0..100%` position feedback on their own point-to-point `WHERE`, and hand off in-flight `set_cover_position` targets seamlessly during mid-move promotion.
- **Sound Diffusion `WHO = 22` Output-Area Decoding & Quiet Single-Retry Negotiation (#916, #924, #929, `OWNd#171`, `OWNd#176`, `OWNd#179`–`#180`)**: `OWNd 2.0.1` (building on `2.0.0`) decodes `<mmtype>#<area>` on `WHO = 22` power-on/off and notifications (`WHAT 0, 1, 2, 21, 22, 23, 34`) into `output_area` / `multimedia_type` rather than a source, and logs single-attempt session negotiation closes that immediately recover on retry (`MH201`) at `DEBUG` instead of `WARNING`.
- **HA Core `2026.8+` Floor, `DeviceInfo` Dataclass Compatibility, Shared-Bus Topology & Diagnostics Accuracy (#915, #921, #931, #937, #939)**: Eliminated deprecated mapping-style `DeviceInfo` access for Home Assistant `2026.12+` (`core#192323`), aligned the minimum Home Assistant Core floor to `2026.8.0`, kept **Bus Topology** selectable when a secondary/standby is the last MyHOME entry, stopped follower/standby gateways from re-creating primary-owned YAML `WHO = 14` / `WHO = 9 / 25` entities, updated `diagnostics.py` (`device_count` + recursive `migrated_yaml_platforms` redaction), and clarified `expose` 2-wire LED/ACK behavior.
- **Marketplace 2026.11+, `Apache-2.0` Docs & Unified Golden Corpus (#906, #922, #923, #929, #942)**: Added Home Assistant `2026.11` Marketplace `categories` (`hubs_protocols.building_automation`) and compliant `hacs.json`; refreshed `Apache-2.0` starting `README.md`, canonical `/latest/` manual, and 7 AST-backed CI doc-contract gates; unified `tests/golden/corpus.json` (`455` fixtures across `21` WHOs via `scripts/sync_golden_corpus.py`) and zero-tolerance CI Trace-Shape Coverage Gate (`tools/golden/check_trace_shape_coverage.py`).

#### 🏛️ Founding Tribute & Ceremonial Final Sign-Off: @anotherjulien

In 2020, **[@anotherjulien](https://github.com/anotherjulien)** created both **MyHOME for Home Assistant** and the **[`OWNd`](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/OWNd)** protocol library from scratch, giving the BTicino and Legrand community its open-source home in Home Assistant. Beyond laying that original groundwork, he created the **[OpenWebNet Encyclopedia](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/OpenWebNet-Encyclopedia)** (1,530+ commits and its structured, provenance-backed **Machine KB** powering `openwebnet-mcp`), providing high-quality, machine-readable protocol, diagnostic (`WHO = 1001 / 1004 / 1013`), and device-model (`MHCatalogue.db` / `OPEN.db` Objects & Modules) insights that dramatically accelerated and grounded `v2.0.0` engineering. As an honor to where this journey began and the knowledge base that powered it, we have invited **@anotherjulien** to give the ceremonial final sign-off on **[PR #232](https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/pull/232)** to bring `v2.0.0` home to `master`.

#### 🌟 Dedicated Recognition: @gdluck

A special, heartfelt thank-you goes to **[@gdluck](https://github.com/gdluck)** for an extraordinary body of engineering and countless late-night hours across the entire OpenWebNet-HA stack — authoring **328 commits across 4 repositories** (**137 commits / 46 merged PRs in `MyHOME`**, **145 commits / 42 merged PRs in `OWNd`**, **40 commits in `own-firmware-oracle`**, and **6 commits in `openwebnet-mcp`**) and wiring up a live multi-gateway hardware lab (`F461`, `F455`, `F524`, `MH200`, `3550` 99-zone central unit, `KW4691`, `F430/2`, `F430/4`, `F411/4`, `F418`, `F429`, `F428`) to verify every hypothesis on physical SCS hardware:
- **Thermoregulation (`WHO = 4` / `1004`)**: Solved the separation of `Dimension 12` (setpoint in force after knob offset) from `Dimension 14` (commanded setpoint) (#791, #810, #812, #820), `Dimension 13` startup local knob offset reads (#902), `Dimension 20` actuator status & `hvac_action` derivation (#792, `OWNd#140`), `Dimension 19` multi-actuator `F455` zone state & repeated actuator-OFF arbitration (#940), the unified `Dimension 19 / 20` output-code table & `bt_thermo_manager` active/inactive bitmask (`OWNd#174`, `OWNd#178`), result-based paced silent-zone post-sweep polling across all gateways (#873, #933), `15 min` (`900 s`) probe fallback reads with NACK/timeout refusal latching and `#886` FIFO desync protection (#938), 41-zone `MyHomeServer1` timeout analysis (#886), `3550` central unit flags and `*4*3100*#0##` weekly program restore (#880, #884, #894, #912, `OWNd#169`), and `WHO 4` `.actuator` / `#4#IF` disambiguation (`OWNd#168`, `OWNd#181`).
- **Protocol Engine (`OWNd`), Encyclopedia Audit & Golden Corpus**: Led the 7-part OpenWebNet Encyclopedia & openHAB comparative audit (#893, `OWNd#155`–`#161`), hardened `WHO 4 Dimension 22` (`OWNd#136`, `OWNd#151`, #849) and `WHO 18 Dimension 52` 4-digit year crash guards (`OWNd#157`), implemented `WHO 0` (`WHAT 40–46`), `WHO 1` preset/step/timer builders & `WHAT 39` motion-end (`OWNd#135`), `WHO 18 Dimension 1200`, `WHO 22` output-area decoding (`OWNd#176`, `OWNd#179`, `OWNd#180`) & bare-power crash refusal (`OWNd#163`, #898), `WHO 25` Scenario Plus (`WHAT 11–15`), `WHO 13 Dimension 27`, `WHO 1001 Dimension 11`, and `WHO 1004` diagnostics, fixed idle command-session reopen (`OWNd#167`) and single-retry negotiation logging (`OWNd#171`), and co-built the canonical `455`-fixture Golden Corpus (`OWNd#173`, `OWNd#175`, #929).
- **Firmware Oracle, Covers, Lighting & Shared-Bus Topologies**: Built the `OwnPlantEngine` (`plant-f461-bench`), `thermo-zone-requests`, `thermo-dim22`, `who13-identification`, and `ownd-audit-frames` suites and `3488 HOMETOUCH` emulation target in `own-firmware-oracle`; delivered timed cover `0.5 s` early end-stop settle (#847) and `unknown` startup state (#795, #820), fine dimmer `Dimension 1` refresh after coarse `WHAT 2..10` echoes (#851, #852), `0004 → 04` Area-0 canonicalization (#798), post-auth manual gateway identification (#804), shared-bus follower deduplication (#896, #915), lone-follower **Bus Topology** recovery (#939), and live plant trace fixtures across `F461`, `F455`, `F459`, `F454`, `MyHomeServer1`, `3488 HOMETOUCH`, and `3550` (#799, #810, #812, #815, #823, #861, #862, #865, #871, #872, #912).

#### 💬 A Personal Note from @GreenGrassBlueOcean

> *"I would like to thank everybody for one hell of a ride. My annoyance with my constantly crashing `MH200` is what led me to pause my work on quantitative programming to build this. I never expected to find so many people who stepped up to help me along the way. Having a background in systems engineering turned out to be exactly what this project needed — I knew very little about the `WHO` protocol or all the different gateways at the start, but you learn extraordinarily fast once you begin recognizing how everything fits together through all the traces, insights, and help shared along the way."* — **[@GreenGrassBlueOcean](https://github.com/GreenGrassBlueOcean)**
